test.create_query: CREATE TABLE sum_k (k UInt64, v1 UInt64, v2 Float64) ENGINE = SummingMergeTree ORDER BY k SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = ''
CREATE TABLE sum_sd (sid UInt32, d Date, page String, hits UInt64, cost Float64) ENGINE = SummingMergeTree ORDER BY (sid, d) SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = ''
CREATE TABLE sum_ins (k UInt64, v1 UInt64, v2 Float64) ENGINE = SummingMergeTree ORDER BY k SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = ''
CREATE TABLE sum_ins_src (k UInt64, v1 UInt64, v2 Float64) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE sum_ts (ts DateTime, hits UInt64, cost Float64) ENGINE = SummingMergeTree ORDER BY ts SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = ''
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO sum_k SELECT intHash64(number), number % 1000 + 1, number / 7 FROM numbers(8000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 8388608, min_insert_block_size_rows = 8388608, max_insert_block_size = 8388608, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

INSERT INTO sum_k SELECT intHash64(cityHash64(number) % 8000000), 1, 0.5 FROM numbers(200000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 20000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 20000, max_insert_block_size = 20000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

INSERT INTO sum_sd SELECT number % 200000, toDate('2026-10-01') + intDiv(number, 200000), concat('/page/', toString(number % 200000)), number % 97 + 1, number / 13 FROM numbers(3000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 4194304, min_insert_block_size_rows = 4194304, max_insert_block_size = 4194304, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

INSERT INTO sum_sd SELECT sid, toDate('2026-10-14') + number % 2, concat('/page/', toString(sid)), 1, 0.25 FROM (SELECT number, cityHash64(number) % 200000 AS sid FROM numbers(100000)) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 10000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 10000, max_insert_block_size = 10000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
INSERT INTO sum_ins_src SELECT intHash64(number), number % 1000 + 1, number / 7 FROM numbers(1000000)

INSERT INTO sum_ts SELECT toDateTime('2026-10-01 00:00:00') + number, number % 97 + 1, number / 13 FROM numbers(3000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 300000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 300000, max_insert_block_size = 300000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
